chapter_title: General Provisions Regarding Imports and Exports
title: Validity of Authorisation/ Licence for import/export

business_rules.rule_description:
2.18 Validity of Authorisation/ Licence for import/export
(a) Authorisations must be valid on the date of import.
business_rules.trigger: Validity of Authorisation/ Licence for import/export
business_rules.condition:
The
affected exports would only be accounted for EO fulfilment only if the authority
concerned approves the EO extension.
business_rules.validation:
2.18 Validity of Authorisation/ Licence for import/export
(a) Authorisations must be valid on the date of import.
business_rules.action:
The
affected exports would only be accounted for EO fulfilment only if the authority
concerned approves the EO extension.
business_rules.exception:
However, AA/ EPCG Authorisation holder(s)may continue to export
post the export obligation period at their own risk and responsibility.
business_rules.output: DEKAI should produce a compliance decision for 2.18 - Validity of Authorisation/ Licence for import/export.
